pinyin: Gǔ shén bù sǐ， shì wèi xuán pìn。
Xuán pìn zhī mén， shì wèi tiān dì gēn。
Mián mián ruò cún， yòng zhī bù qín。
english: The spirit of emptiness is immortal. It is called the Great Mother because it gives birth to Heaven and Earth.
It is like a vapor, barely seen but always present. Use it effortlessly.
